create_component_subclass: create a python subclass of Component implementing input_spec output_spec and _unroll method
build_batched_component: build a BatchedComponent subclass implementing _forward to process single timesteps without state
chain_sequential_components: build a SequentialComponent by appending multiple Components to chain their outputs together
review_component_specs: review the input_spec prev_state_spec output_spec and next_state_spec properties of a Component
test_component_unroll: test a Component unroll method by passing StreamDict inputs and prev_state arguments
